account.invalidLink: This link is invalid or has expired.
account.emailTaken: An account with this email already exists.
account.passwordBreached: This password has appeared in a data breach: choose another one.
account.passwordCheckUnavailable: Passwords can't be checked right now: try again in a minute.
account.passwordReused: This password was used before: choose one you haven't used recently.
account.serverBusy: The service is busy: try again shortly.
account.reauthenticationFailed: The password or the code is wrong.
account.reauthenticationIncomplete: Your password, and your code when two-factor is on, are required.
account.reauthenticationUnavailable: Your account has no password, two-factor or passkey: sign in again with an email link or a provider.
account.passkeyRegistrationFailed: The passkey couldn't be registered: try again.
account.passkeyLimit: An account can hold {max} passkeys: remove one first.
account.lastSignInMethod: This is your only way to sign in: set a password or add another way first.
account.onboardingNotPending: This account has no onboarding step to do.
account.placeholderEmail: Enter a real email address, not a placeholder.
account.mfaAlreadyOn: Two-factor is already on: turn it off first.
account.identityTaken: This identity is connected to another account.

resetPassword.subject: Reset your password
resetPassword.intro: Someone asked to reset the password of your account. If it was you, choose a new one:
resetPassword.note: The link works once. If you didn't ask, ignore this email: your password stays as it is.

invitation.subject: You're invited to {app}
invitation.intro: You've been invited to {app}. Choose a password to activate your account:

verifyEmail.subject: Confirm your email address
verifyEmail.intro: Please confirm that this is your email address:
verifyEmail.note: If you didn't create an account, ignore this email.

magicLink.subject: Your sign-in link
magicLink.intro: Here is your sign-in link. Open it in the browser where you asked for it:
magicLink.note: The link works once. If you didn't ask for it, ignore this email.

mail.securityFooter: You receive this email because it concerns the security of your {app} account.

newSignIn.subject: New sign-in to your account
newSignIn.body: Your account was signed in from {device} ({ip}). If this wasn't you, change your password and sign out everywhere.

passwordChanged.subject: Your password was changed
passwordChanged.body: The password of your account was changed (from {ip}). If this wasn't you, reset it right away.

passwordBreached.subject: Your password appeared in a data breach
passwordBreached.body: The password of your account appears in a known data breach, so others may try it. Change it now, to one you use nowhere else.

mfaEnabled.subject: Two-factor sign-in turned on
mfaEnabled.body: Two-factor sign-in was turned on for your account (from {ip}). If this wasn't you, change your password right away.

mfaDisabled.subject: Two-factor sign-in turned off
mfaDisabled.body: Two-factor sign-in was turned off for your account (from {ip}). If this wasn't you, change your password right away.

passkeyAdded.subject: A passkey was added to your account
passkeyAdded.body: A passkey named “{name}” was added to your account (from {ip}). If this wasn't you, remove it and change your password right away.

passkeyRemoved.subject: A passkey was removed from your account
passkeyRemoved.body: The passkey “{name}” was removed from your account (from {ip}). If this wasn't you, change your password right away.
